QuestInfo.name: Fly Airplane, Fly!
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra asked if you heard about the new personal airplane at the station platform. She's really curious about it, so if you give it a try and tell her about it, she'll give you a #b7-day Pink Scooter Coupon#k. \nSee Cassandra after riding the airplane. \r\n#bTravel from one continent to another on the airplane #e#R11173##n / Complete 1 time.
QuestInfo.2: You rode the airplane, and returned to Cassandra to tell her all about it.
QuestInfo.summary: From the Platform, take the Wooden Airplane or Red Airplane.

0.0: Hey, did you hear about the Airplane? Yeah, there's apparently a new private Airplane at the station platforms, that can take you anywhere on command!.You wouldn't have to wait for Airships anymore!
0.1: I really, really want to ride it, but I just have no time, what with all my responsibilities and stuff. Now, if you ride it, #h0#, you can tell me all about it. Will you do that for me? If you do, I'll give you a nice gift.

yes.0: Wow! This is so exciting. Okay, hurry up and try it, and then tell me about it.

1.0: How was it? How was the plane ride? Tell me, tell me!\r\n#L0##bIt was amazing. Not having to wait was wonderful. You can't meet other people on the flight, but you can't beat it for convenience.#l\n#k
1.1: You've made me want to try it more than ever! Oh, right, I have a gift for you, don't I?

yes.0: Planes are great for flying around, but for daily life, a scooter is much more fun. Try learning to ride one over the next week.

default.0: Can you go to the station platform and try taking the Airplane to another place? If you try it and tell me about it, I'll give you something nice.
